messages.subject: Comparision different kinds of models
parts:
Hi dear all!
I have a question about comparison models with Inal, I have two kind of different model, joint model and linear mixed model, i want to compare them, but with DIC reported in inla for these two models i can not have a logical interpretation. Is there any other criterion which could be calculated by inla? which criteria for two different kind of model with different structure is more reliable?

Regards

messages.author: 9940b4fcc153c7d7
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Comparision different kinds of models
parts:
If you want to compare models in a good way, you have to do out-of-sample predictive comparison, like cross-validation. This must be manually implemented by the user.

Regards,
Haakon
